question: How many orders are pending?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending'

question: What is the name of the cheapest product?
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

question: How many cities have more than 3 customers?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT city FROM customers GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 3)

question: List the names of products in the Home category
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Home'

question: Names of customers who have placed at least one cancelled order
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled'

question: How many different customers have placed a completed order?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'

question: Which customer has placed the most orders? Return only the name
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total value of all pending orders, where value is quantity times product price?
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'pending'

question: Names of customers whose name starts with the letter A
reference_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'A%'

question: List the 3 most expensive products with their prices
reference_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3

question: How many orders were placed before March 2026?
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date < '2026-03-01'

question: Which customer has spent the most in total across all their orders, where spending is quantity times product price? Return only the name
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) DESC LIMIT 1
